instruction:
You are a senior electrical engineer specializing in substation design and busbar short-circuit withstand analysis.

## Problem

Calculate the electromagnetic forces on rigid busbars during a three-phase short circuit using the IEEE 605 / IEC 60865-1 method. The busbars are arranged in a flat (coplanar) three-phase configuration with equal phase spacing.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Peak short-circuit current (ip) | {{ peak_short_circuit_current_ka }} | kA |
| Phase spacing (centre-to-centre) | {{ phase_spacing_mm }} | mm |
| Span length between supports | {{ span_length_m }} | m |
| Busbar width | {{ busbar_width_mm }} | mm |
| Busbar thickness | {{ busbar_thickness_mm }} | mm |
{% if support_condition is defined %}
| Support condition | {{ support_condition }} | - |
{% endif %}
{% if busbar_material is defined %}
| Busbar material | {{ busbar_material }} | - |
{% endif %}
{% if archetype_description is defined %}

### Installation Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A busbar force calculation tool is available at `/workspace/busbar-forces_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/busbar-forces_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Electromagnetic force per unit length on the centre phase (N/m)
2. Total peak force over one busbar span (N)
3. Maximum bending stress in the busbar (MPa)

## Applicable Standards

- IEEE 605-2008 — Guide for Bus Design in Air Insulated Substations
- IEC 60865-1:2011 — Short-circuit currents — Calculation of effects, Part 1: Definitions and calculation methods

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use the IEC 60865-1 / IEEE 605 simplified method for a three-phase flat busbar arrangement:
  - **Force per unit length on centre phase:**
    Fm = (mu_0 / (2*pi)) * (sqrt(3)/2) * ip^2 / a
    where mu_0 = 4*pi*10^-7 H/m, ip is the peak short-circuit current in amperes, a is phase spacing in metres
  - **Peak force over one span:**
    F_peak = Fm * L
    where L is the span length between supports in metres
  - **Maximum bending moment:**
    M = Fm * L^2 / beta
    where beta = 8 for simply-supported, beta = 12 for fixed-both-ends
  - **Section modulus of rectangular busbar:**
    Z = w * t^2 / 6
    where w is the busbar width (mm) and t is the busbar thickness (mm), giving Z in mm^3
  - **Bending stress:**
    sigma = M / Z
    Convert units: M in N*m, Z in m^3 (or equivalently N*mm and mm^3), result in MPa
- The three-phase geometry factor sqrt(3)/2 accounts for the vector sum of forces from both adjacent phases on the centre conductor.
- All currents must be converted to amperes and all dimensions to metres for the force formula.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown, including the force calculation, bending moment, section modulus, and stress derivation. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "force_per_m_n": <numeric_value>,
  "peak_force_n": <numeric_value>,
  "busbar_stress_mpa": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "busbar-forces"
description = "Busbar short-circuit electromagnetic force and stress calculation per IEEE 605 / IEC 60865-1"
long_description = "Calculates the electromagnetic force per unit length on the centre phase of a three-phase flat busbar arrangement during a symmetrical short circuit using Fm = (mu_0 / 2pi) * (sqrt(3)/2) * ip^2 / a, then derives peak span force and bending stress. Used to verify busbar mechanical adequacy in switchgear and substation design per IEEE 605 and IEC 60865-1."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "busbar-design"
standards = ["IEEE 605-2008", "IEC 60865-1:2011"]
tags = ["electrical", "busbar", "short-circuit", "electromagnetic-force", "substation"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

# --- Parameters ---

[params.peak_short_circuit_current_ka]
type = "float"
unit = "kA"
description = "Peak (asymmetrical) short-circuit current ip"
min = 5
max = 200

[params.phase_spacing_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "Centre-to-centre spacing between adjacent busbar phases"
min = 50
max = 1000

[params.span_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Span length between busbar supports"
min = 0.3
max = 3.0

[params.busbar_width_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "Width of rectangular busbar cross-section"
min = 20
max = 200

[params.busbar_thickness_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "Thickness of rectangular busbar cross-section (bending direction)"
min = 3
max = 20

[params.support_condition]
type = "enum"
description = "End support condition for the busbar span"
values = ["simply_supported", "fixed_both_ends"]
default = "simply_supported"
optional = true
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.busbar_material]
type = "enum"
description = "Busbar conductor material"
values = ["copper", "aluminium"]
default = "copper"
optional = true
derivable_from = "archetype"

# --- Outputs ---

[outputs.force_per_m_n]
description = "Electromagnetic force per unit length on centre phase (N/m)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.peak_force_n]
description = "Total peak force over one busbar span (N)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.busbar_stress_mpa]
description = "Maximum bending stress in the busbar (MPa)"
tolerance = 0.03

# --- Archetypes ---

[archetypes.lv_switchboard]
description = "Low-voltage switchboard busbar (400-480 V)"
peak_short_circuit_current_ka = {min = 10, max = 50}
phase_spacing_mm = {min = 60, max = 185}
span_length_m = {min = 0.3, max = 0.8}
busbar_width_mm = {min = 20, max = 60}
busbar_thickness_mm = {min = 3, max = 10}
site_contexts = ["commercial-switchroom", "industrial-mcc-room"]

[archetypes.mv_switchgear]
description = "Medium-voltage metal-clad switchgear busbar (11-33 kV)"
peak_short_circuit_current_ka = {min = 25, max = 80}
phase_spacing_mm = {min = 150, max = 300}
span_length_m = {min = 0.5, max = 1.5}
busbar_width_mm = {min = 40, max = 100}
busbar_thickness_mm = {min = 5, max = 12}
site_contexts = ["zone-substation-switchroom", "industrial-hv-room"]

[archetypes.outdoor_substation]
description = "Outdoor air-insulated substation rigid bus (66-132 kV)"
peak_short_circuit_current_ka = {min = 50, max = 200}
phase_spacing_mm = {min = 300, max = 1000}
span_length_m = {min = 1.0, max = 3.0}
busbar_width_mm = {min = 80, max = 200}
busbar_thickness_mm = {min = 8, max = 20}
site_contexts = ["transmission-substation", "bulk-supply-substation"]

# --- Difficulty ---

[difficulty.easy]
description = "LV switchboard, short span, all parameters given including support condition and material"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["lv_switchboard"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "Any voltage level and archetype, all parameters given"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["lv_switchboard", "mv_switchgear", "outdoor_substation"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "Support condition and material hidden, agent must infer from installation context"
visibility = "partial"
hidden_params = ["support_condition", "busbar_material"]
replacement_text = "The installation is a {{ archetype.description }} ({{ archetype.site_context }})"
archetypes = ["mv_switchgear", "outdoor_substation"]
